text_block_list.text:
Spring of the Senior Class has arrived.
Lately, Mayano Top Gun's training has been—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan!
Running three laps around the track is boring!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The current Maya's gotta do 30 laps!
choice_data_list: You're pushing your legs way too hard.
You're putting too much strain on your legs.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! In that case, in that case,
hurry up and think of our next training?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya knows Trainer-chan will
definitely show me a good time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I can already do all the exercises
on the list you gave me yesterday!
I want something else~☆

"...And day after day, they keep
demanding new training menus from me."
However, Mayano Top Gun set her own goal and wanted to do her best. Giving her a push to support that is a Trainer's job, after all—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'! Trainer-chan!
Let's do our best again today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer-chan?
Your face looks completely pale...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa there, careful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You were one step away from collapsing, you know.
choice_data_list: Were you the one supporting me...?
Were you the one supporting me...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no need for thanks.
It was nothing, really.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Man, you've got huge bags under your eyes...
Looks like you haven't been sleeping much, huh."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Come on, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: H-Hawawa...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mayano! Don't chicken out, answer me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: H-Hyep!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, alright. Well then, Mayano's Trainer.
You just rest right there.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll take care of this one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't panic.
It's not like I'm gonna eat you alive.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That declaration of war at the Arima Kinen the other day...
Honestly, it sent shivers down my spine."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So let me get in on this action too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I don't plan on letting you keep a kid with this much potential all to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!? Hishi Ama-san did...!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa...!? S-Sorry, okay?
Maya only has eyes for Trainer-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...No, hold on, don't get ahead of yourself.
This is just a suggestion.
Just asking, "Do you want to get stronger?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Mayano's Trainer?
Wanna leave her in my hands for a bit?

――The "Amazon" Hishi Amazon.
She stood as Narita Brian's fierce rival
in the Arima Kinen, both last year and this year.

If I truly care about Mayano Top Gun,
I shouldn't cling stubbornly to my own plans—
I need to rely on her, too...!
choice_data_list: Please, I'd love to ask you to do it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit!
Time to kick off training, Hishi Ama style!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So basically, Mayano. You gotta run around
and make sure I don't catch your tail.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you mean "Tail Tag"?
Maya used to play that back in kindergarten, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Is this really training?
...Doesn't it kinda feel like just messing around?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Aren't we confident.
Well then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: U-Urrrgh……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, what's wrong?
You've already been tagged more than 10 times!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because Hishi Ama-san is playing dirty!
Suddenly increasing the number of demons and all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Next time, I'm the one
who's gonna catch Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like things are getting lively...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, Hishi Ama-san.
Is this way of helping out alright with you~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's plenty! Thanks!
...Now then, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Your weakness,
to put it plainly, is a lack of awareness.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...A realization?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Isn't a 'realization' just understanding something?
Then Maya already knows! The rules, and how to run away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Still, Hishiama-san keeps changing the rules and the number of taggers right away! That's not fair—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's why I'm saying you don't notice... No,
you're not even *trying* to notice.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, you seem to have been blessed
with both talent and a great Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You really can do just about anything, huh?
That's why the adults around you give you
all sorts of things for your sake.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Even so, you depended on that far too much.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's the same even now. Once you figure it out—
or rather, once you think you've figured it out...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Not trying to understand anything outside your own scope."
...That's a habit you made for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What I'm doing isn't "tail tag." It's race training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Think about it some more. In an actual race, anyone might mark you.
Strategies can even change mid-race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then what do you do? You twist away and escape
according to the situation... right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...For that matter, even this morning...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Did you even realize that your Trainer
was pushing themselves way too hard for your sake?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You've got real talent.
So don't hold back—use it for all it's worth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Or are you gonna act like a brat crying 'I wanna quit!',
making things hard on your Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmh! That's not true at all!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya is gonna become a mature woman!
I won't cry!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san! One more time!!
Next time Maya is totally gonna run away with the lead!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nice.
Alright then, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! One more!
I've got it "figured out" now--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Keep it up, keep it up!
Burn it into your body, not your head!

—And under the glittering sunset,
drenched in sweat,
they continued running laps around the track.
